# Koina Allied Health — Comprehensive Knowledge Base
Entity: Koina Pty Ltd (Trading as Koina Allied Health)
Sister Entity: Hopesway Pty Ltd
Main Location: Queensland, Australia
Central Contact: contact@koina.com.au
Website: https://www.koina.com.au

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Purpose
Koina Allied Health provides multidisciplinary in-home, mobile community, and telehealth healthcare services across Queensland, Australia. Designed to support individuals at every stage of life, Koina prioritizes clinical excellence, mutual trust, and practical accountability. Koina operates without static physical clinics; qualified clinicians travel directly to participants' homes, day centres, workplaces, or schools, ensuring therapy occurs within the participant's everyday functional environment.

## 2. Clinical Disciplines & Scopes of Practice

### 2.1 Occupational Therapy (OT)
- Clinical Registration: AHPRA Registered Occupational Therapists
- Service Offerings:
  - Functional Capacity Assessments (FCA) for NDIS plan reviews and NDIA funding justification
  - Assistive Technology (AT Level 1–4) clinical justification, trials, and prescription
  - Environmental home modifications (grab rails, access ramps, accessible bathroom remodels)
  - Daily living skill development (personal care routines, meal preparation, executive functioning)
  - Supported Independent Living (SIL) and Specialist Disability Accommodation (SDA) housing suitability assessments
  - Sensory processing profiles and ergonomic home environment strategies

### 2.2 Physiotherapy
- Clinical Registration: AHPRA Registered Physiotherapists
- Service Offerings:
  - Comprehensive mobility, gait, and transfer evaluations
  - Proactive falls prevention, vestibular rehabilitation, and balance retraining
  - Neurological rehabilitation (stroke recovery, Parkinson’s disease, Multiple Sclerosis, cerebral palsy)
  - Musculoskeletal injury rehabilitation and chronic pain conditioning
  - Post-hospitalization and post-orthopedic surgery reablement programs
  - Prescribed home exercise routines tailored to available home space

### 2.3 Speech Pathology
- Clinical Certification: Certified Practising Speech Pathologists (Speech Pathology Australia - SPA)
- Service Offerings:
  - Clinical dysphagia swallowing assessments and safe mealtime management
  - Mealtime management plans complying with the NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission guidelines and IDDSI standards
  - Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) device evaluation, trials, mounting, and training
  - Speech articulation, language pathology, and voice therapy
  - Cognitive communication rehabilitation following acquired brain injury (ABI) or stroke

### 2.4 Positive Behaviour Support (PBS)
- Compliance: NDIS Commission Registered Behaviour Support Practitioners
- Service Offerings:
  - Functional Behaviour Assessments (FBA) exploring environmental triggers and communication functions
  - Interim Behaviour Support Plans (BSPs) and Comprehensive Behaviour Support Plans
  - Safe reduction and elimination of chemical, mechanical, environmental, or physical restrictive practices
  - Hands-on trauma-informed coaching for families, support workers, and care teams

### 2.5 Therapy Assistants (Allied Health Assistants - AHAs)
- Supervision: Clinically Supervised by primary OT, Physiotherapist, or Speech Pathologist
- Service Offerings:
  - High-frequency exercise repetition and routine therapy reinforcement
  - Budget optimization: lower hourly billing rates maximize total therapy hours under NDIS budgets
  - Community access and practical real-world skill practice (public transport, local shops, recreational venues)

### 2.6 Clinical Assessment Specialists (RN & Allied Health)
- Clinical Credentials: AHPRA Registered Nurses (RN) and senior Allied Health clinicians
- Service Offerings:
  - Registered Nurse-led complex health evaluations and nursing reviews
  - Comprehensive Continence Assessments and product prescription
  - Rapid-turnaround clinical reporting for scheduled NDIS plan reviews and Home Care Package reassessments

## 3. Funding Streams & Financial Arrangements

### 3.1 NDIS (National Disability Insurance Scheme)
- Eligibility: Plan-Managed and Self-Managed participants statewide
- Support Categories:
  - Capacity Building: CB Daily Living (Improved Daily Living Skills), CB Relationships
  - Core Supports: Delivered via clinically supervised Allied Health Assistants (AHAs)
- Pricing: Strict 100% adherence to the official NDIS Support Catalogue and Price Guide caps. Zero gap fees or surprise markups.

### 3.2 My Aged Care & Home Care Packages (HCP)
- Eligibility: Older Australians with Home Care Packages (Levels 1, 2, 3, and 4) or Commonwealth Home Support Programme (CHSP)
- Invoicing: Direct invoicing to nominated Care Managers or Package Providers with zero out-of-pocket costs for clients

### 3.3 Department of Veterans' Affairs (DVA)
- Eligibility: Gold Card holders (for all clinically indicated conditions) and White Card holders (for accepted service-related conditions)
- Invoicing: 100% direct billing to DVA through Medicare/DVA schedules with valid GP Form D904 referral. Zero out-of-pocket costs.

### 3.4 Private & Medicare Chronic Disease Management (CDM)
- Eligibility: Any individual seeking direct therapy without third-party delay
- Invoicing: Itemized tax receipts issued for private health insurance extras rebates or Medicare CDM/EPC rebate claiming

## 4. Queensland Geographic Coverage Hubs
Koina provides mobile in-home visits and secure statewide telehealth across 13 major regions:
1. Gold Coast: Robina, Southport, Broadbeach, Burleigh Waters, Helensvale, Coomera, Nerang, Surfers Paradise, Palm Beach, Tweed border
2. Brisbane South & Logan: Upper Mount Gravatt, Sunnybank, Springwood, Browns Plains, Beenleigh, Indooroopilly, Carindale
3. Brisbane North & Moreton Bay: Chermside, Aspley, Strathpine, Redcliffe, North Lakes, Caboolture, Morayfield, Sandgate
4. Ipswich & Western Corridor: Ipswich Central, Springfield Central, Goodna, Brassall, Ripley, Yamanto, Boonah
5. Sunshine Coast: Maroochydore, Caloundra, Kawana Waters, Buderim, Nambour, Coolum Beach, Noosa Heads
6. Toowoomba & Darling Downs: Toowoomba City, Rangeville, Highfields, Kearneys Spring, Drayton, Oakey, Dalby
7. Wide Bay & Burnett: Hervey Bay, Maryborough, Bundaberg, Bargara, Kingaroy, Gympie
8. Central Queensland: Rockhampton, Gracemere, Gladstone, Tannum Sands, Yeppoon, Emerald
9. Mackay & Whitsundays: Mackay, North Mackay, Walkerston, Sarina, Airlie Beach, Proserpine
10. Townsville: Townsville City, Thuringowa, Kirwan, Annandale, Douglas, North Ward
11. Cairns & Far North Queensland: Cairns City, Smithfield, Edmonton, Gordonvale, Palm Cove, Atherton Tablelands
12. Statewide Telehealth: High-definition encrypted video therapy sessions connecting regional and remote Queensland communities with zero travel charges.

## 5. Referral & Clinical Intake Process
1. Online Intake Portal: Available at https://www.koina.com.au/referral (takes ~2 minutes to submit).
2. Direct Documentation Email: Plans, medical summaries, and GP forms can be emailed directly to contact@koina.com.au.
3. Clinical Intake Triage: Every referral is reviewed by a qualified clinical intake coordinator within 24 business hours.
4. Therapist Capacity Matching: Matched with qualified local clinician within 48–72 hours.
5. Service Agreement & First Session: Transparent service agreement provided with clear goals, frequency, and fee structure prior to initial home visit.
